Beginner.learningGoal: Build and format strings correctly: interpolation, StringBuilder, culture-aware formatting.
gotchas: String concatenation in a loop is O(n²)
ToString() uses the current culture; use invariant for machine formats
goodSolutionShows: Readable interpolated strings with format specifiers
shapeHints: building a CSV line for an export

Intermediate.learningGoal: Handle text robustly: normalisation, comparison, splitting and truncation.
gotchas: Truncating in the middle of a surrogate pair or combining character
ToLower() for comparison instead of OrdinalIgnoreCase
Split without options leaves empty entries and whitespace
shapeHints: a notification preview truncated to N characters
a slug generator for article titles

Expert.learningGoal: Write allocation-aware formatting with interpolated string handlers and ISpanFormattable.
gotchas: $"..." allocates even when the log level is off, unless a handler defers it
TryFormat must report charsWritten and return false when the buffer is too small
goodSolutionShows: A custom interpolated string handler or string.Create
shapeHints: a strongly typed ID that formats without allocating
